title: Contrasting Agile, CI/CD, and Waterfall
html:
The Waterfall Model: One Direction, One Chance

The Waterfall model is the most traditional approach to software development. It organizes work into a fixed sequence of phases, where each phase must be fully completed before the next one begins — much like water flowing over a series of steps.
🎨 Nền ô:
Phase
What Happens
RequirementsAll business needs are documented upfront
System DesignArchitects create the technical blueprint
ImplementationDevelopers write the code
TestingQA tests the completed product
DeploymentThe product is released to users
MaintenanceBugs are fixed post-release
